officialCrossCheck.name: MITECO open-data / RIPREE public charging dataset
officialCrossCheck.scope: infraestructura de recarga electrica de vehiculos de acceso publico
officialCrossCheck.lineage: requests submitted by public-access CPOs and EMSPs to RIPREE

rationale: Red Electrica explicitly describes REVE as the map/network of public EV charging points.
Spanish regulation requires publication and information transmission for public-access EV charging infrastructure.
The MITECO national open dataset independently defines its population as public-access EV charging infrastructure.
Private infrastructure restricted to a limited and determined group is legally distinguished from public-access infrastructure.

Therefore TCC V9 must not infer private/non-public status from private land, commercial parking, opening hours, or customer-site context when the station is present in the official public-access source.

v9Policy.exceptionRule: Only override/exclude a specific station when authoritative station-level evidence proves the source record is erroneous or access has changed to a restricted private group.
